  - type: derives_from

  - option: opt-out telemetry enabled by default, like many CLI tools ship
    why_not: >
      a tool trusted with private strategic rationale phoning home by

No usage tracking and no telemetry, on the happy path or otherwise,
matching `cst-0004`. A local, offline `--stats` view of the ledger's own
entry counts — never transmitted — is compliant; a network call reporting
the same numbers is not. Fixture entry for `internal/enforcer`.
